newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude trades shade weaker in US aftermarket.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude trades shade weaker in US aftermarket.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil traded a shade weaker in late U.S. dealings on Tuesday, traders said.
Four September Brent partial cargoes changed hands, three at $18.37 and one at $18.35 for a total of 475 lots.
September Brent on London's IPE settled at $18.38.
August/September Brent traded twice, once each at minus five cents and minus four and a half cents a barrel.
The spread traded earlier in the day at minus seven cents.
